accountLegend.api: Free account needed for the API only

sites.name: VirusTotal
sites.desc: Checks a hash, file, URL, domain or IP against ~70 antivirus engines and reputation feeds.

sites.name: MalwareBazaar
sites.desc: Database of known malware samples, searchable by hash, family or tag.

sites.name: URLhaus
sites.desc: Database of URLs known to distribute malware.

sites.name: ThreatFox
sites.desc: Indicators of compromise (IPs, domains, hashes) tied to malware families.

sites.name: Hybrid Analysis
sites.desc: Free sandbox: runs a file and reports what it did.

sites.name: ANY.RUN
sites.desc: Interactive sandbox you watch live.

sites.name: CyberChef
sites.desc: "Cyber Swiss Army knife": encode, decode, hash, decrypt and parse data in the browser.

sites.name: hashes.com hash identifier
sites.desc: Identifies a hash type from its format.

sites.name: ICANN Lookup
sites.desc: Official domain registration lookup (RDAP, the successor to WHOIS).

sites.name: crt.sh
sites.desc: Certificate transparency search: every certificate issued for a domain, which reveals subdomains.

sites.name: MXToolbox
sites.desc: DNS, MX, SPF, DMARC and blocklist checks.

sites.name: DNSDumpster
sites.desc: Maps a domain's DNS records and hosts.

sites.name: SecurityTrails
sites.desc: Historical DNS and WHOIS records.

sites.name: urlscan.io
sites.desc: Loads a URL in a sandbox browser and shows screenshots, requests and verdict.

sites.name: Google Safe Browsing site status
sites.desc: Whether Google flags a site as unsafe.

sites.name: SSL Labs
sites.desc: Grades a site's TLS configuration.

sites.name: securityheaders.com
sites.desc: Grades a site's HTTP security headers.

sites.name: AbuseIPDB
sites.desc: Community abuse reports for an IP, with a confidence score.

sites.name: GreyNoise
sites.desc: Whether an IP is internet-wide scanning "noise" or something targeted.

sites.name: Shodan
sites.desc: Search engine for internet-connected devices: open ports, banners, known CVEs.

sites.name: Censys
sites.desc: Shodan alternative focused on hosts and certificates.

sites.name: AlienVault OTX
sites.desc: Open threat exchange: community "pulses" of indicators.

sites.name: IPinfo
sites.desc: IP owner, network (ASN) and location.

sites.name: Have I Been Pwned
sites.desc: Whether an email appeared in a data breach.

sites.name: Have I Been Pwned: Passwords
sites.desc: Checks a password against breached-password lists without sending it.

sites.name: MITRE ATT&CK Groups
sites.desc: Profiles of APT groups (including Chinese, Russian, Iranian and North Korean groups) and the techniques they use.

sites.name: MITRE ATT&CK Navigator
sites.desc: Heat-map of techniques for a group or for your defenses.

sites.name: Malpedia
sites.desc: Encyclopedia of malware families and the actors behind them.

sites.name: CISA advisories
sites.desc: US government advisories, including joint ones on state-sponsored actors.

sites.name: ETDA Threat Group Cards
sites.desc: Cross-reference of APT group names across vendors.

sites.name: NVD
sites.desc: US National Vulnerability Database: CVE details and CVSS scores.

sites.name: CISA KEV
sites.desc: CVEs confirmed exploited in the wild.

sites.name: FIRST EPSS
sites.desc: Probability a CVE will be exploited in the next 30 days.

sites.name: OSV.dev
sites.desc: Known vulnerabilities by open-source package and version.

sites.name: Exploit-DB
sites.desc: Archive of public exploits (the source of searchsploit).

sites.name: CVE Explainer
sites.desc: Ask questions about a CVE in plain English (a chat app by the same author).

sites.name: TryHackMe
sites.desc: Guided hands-on security labs.

sites.name: Hack The Box
sites.desc: Practice machines and challenges.

sites.name: OverTheWire
sites.desc: Classic command-line wargames.

sites.name: GTFOBins
sites.desc: Unix binaries that can be abused to bypass restrictions (privilege escalation reference).

sites.name: LOLBAS
sites.desc: The Windows equivalent of GTFOBins.
